title: Tech news today, 17 November 2026

items.headline: High volume phishing campaign uses Microsoft 365 outage lures to target multiple industry sectors
items.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence observed a high-volume phishing campaign using Microsoft 365 outage-themed lures to target organizations across multiple sectors worldwide. The post High volume phishing campaign uses Microsoft 365 outage lures to target multiple industry sectors appeared first on Microsoft Security Blog .
lines: Microsoft Threat Intelligence observed a high-volume phishing campaign that uses Microsoft 365 outage-themed lures to target organizations across multiple sectors worldwide.
IT teams may need to remind users that unexpected outage notices can be phishing lures and should be verified through official channels.

items.headline: Share skills and add files from Google Drive, Gemini Notebook and Google Photos to your skills in the Gemini app

Recipients are notified by email and can review the skill before installing it. Once added, Gemini can use the skill automatically when it's relevant, or recipients can @mention it in a chat. lines: Google added shareable skills to the Gemini app, letting users share any skill with others and grant View or Edit permissions.
Recipients receive an email notice and can review a skill before installing it.
Users can now include files from Google Drive, Gemini Notebook and Google Photos when creating or uploading a skill.

items.headline: Control where GitHub Copilot customizations come from
items.summary: As an enterprise administrator, you can now require selected GitHub Copilot customizations to come from plugins or managed settings, rather than standalone user or project configuration. Combined with marketplace restrictions,… The post Control where GitHub Copilot customizations come from appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
lines: Enterprise administrators can now require selected GitHub Copilot customizations to come from plugins or managed settings.
The requirement applies instead of standalone user or project configuration and can be combined with marketplace restrictions.
Admins gain more control over where Copilot customizations originate.

items.headline: Amazon EBS now supports associating additional KMS keys with snapshots
items.summary: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) now supports associating additional AWS Key Management Service (KMS) keys with EBS snapshots. This new capability enables you to share and copy encrypted snapshots across accounts without first re-encrypting them, simplifying your disaster recovery and backup workflows. Customers use EBS snapshots as durable, point-in-time backups of EBS volumes. By associating an additional customer-managed KMS key (CMK) with a snapshot encrypted with an AWS managed key (AMK), for example, you enable cross-account sharing for that snapshot without re-encrypting its data. This feature accelerates your disaster recovery workflows and enhances operational efficiency for enterpr
lines: Amazon EBS now supports associating additional AWS KMS keys with EBS snapshots.
The change lets customers share and copy encrypted snapshots across accounts without first re-encrypting them.
The capability can simplify disaster recovery and backup workflows.

items.headline: AWS DevOps Agent is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
items.summary: Now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West), AWS DevOps Agent is your always-available operations teammate that resolves and proactively prevents incidents, optimizes application reliability and performance, and handles on-demand SRE tasks across AWS, multicloud, and on-prem environments. lines: AWS DevOps Agent is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West).
Availability: AWS GovCloud (US-West).
The agent triages incidents across AWS, multicloud and on-prem environments, which may help GovCloud operations teams reduce resolution times.

items.headline: Amazon Connect Health medical coding is now available in public preview
items.summary: Today, AWS announces the public preview of medical coding in Amazon Connect Health , a HIPAA-eligible AI service that works alongside healthcare teams across patient engagement and point-of-care workflows. Medical coding uses existing clinical documentation to suggest ICD-10-CM and CPT codes, including E&M levels and modifiers, for a provider or coder to review and approve before submission. You can integrate medical coding into your EHR or billing application through the Amazon Connect Health SDK, or use it with Amazon Connect Health ambient documentation. Each code links to the evidence that supports it and carries a confidence score, so reviewers can confirm a code before a claim goes out
lines: AWS announced the public preview of medical coding in Amazon Connect Health, a HIPAA-eligible AI service.
Medical coding suggests ICD-10-CM and CPT codes from clinical documentation for a provider or coder to review and approve before submission.
Health IT and billing teams can integrate it into an EHR or billing application through the Amazon Connect Health SDK.

items.headline: Google Project Zero cuts bug disclosures to 30 days amid AI threats
items.summary: Google Project Zero will replace its "90+30" disclosure policy with shorter, fixed deadlines in response to AI-accelerated vulnerability discovery and exploitation. [...]
lines: Reported by BleepingComputer: Google Project Zero will replace its "90+30" disclosure policy with shorter, fixed deadlines.
The change responds to AI-accelerated vulnerability discovery and exploitation.
Security teams may need to plan for faster patching of vulnerabilities disclosed under the new deadlines.

items.headline: United Airlines system outage disrupts departures just days after the big ground stop
items.summary: Less than a week after an issue with air traffic control communications and radar caused the FAA to halt takeoffs nationwide, United Airlines departing flights are being disrupted by an outage. At 6:13PM ET, United said the problem has been fixed: Earlier today we experienced a technology-related issue that impacted some departing flights. The issue […]
lines: Reported by The Verge: Less than a week after an air traffic control communications and radar issue led the FAA to halt takeoffs nationwide, United Airlines said a technology-related issue disrupted some departing flights.
At 6:13PM ET, United said the problem had been fixed.
Business travelers and teams planning trips may face schedule changes during such disruptions.

The cybersecurity and automation company said it is working with outside investigators to understand the scale of the breach.

items.headline: Uber says hackers stole information on close to 150,000 driver’s licenses during data breach
items.summary: The ride-sharing giant said driver's license information stored by AI cloud company Fireworks AI was stolen during a security incident.
lines: Reported by TechCrunch: Uber said hackers stole information on close to 150,000 driver's licenses during a data breach.
The driver's license information was stored by AI cloud company Fireworks AI and was stolen during a security incident.
Business users who share driver records with third-party vendors may want to review how those vendors handle data.

items.headline: United Airlines has fixed issue that caused 'widespread system outage'

lines: Reported by Engadget: United Airlines said it fixed an issue that caused a widespread system outage.

items.headline: Barracuda links cloud breach to ARTEX AI-powered cyberattack
items.summary: Hackers who breached the cloud environment of network and email security company Barracuda earlier this month used a stolen cloud access key and the ARTEX AI penetration testing framework. [...]
lines: Reported by BleepingComputer: Hackers who breached the cloud environment of network and email security company Barracuda earlier this month used a stolen cloud access key.
The attackers also used the ARTEX AI penetration testing framework, and the breach has been linked to an ARTEX AI-powered cyberattack.
Admins who use Barracuda cloud services may want to review access keys and related credentials.
